title: Vietnam Electronics Line Capacity
thesis: Snowflake turns daily line data from a synthetic network of Vietnamese electronics assembly lines into plan-attainment KPIs, 7-day constraint-risk scores, throughput gap anomalies and grounded AI answers, all on curated dynamic tables.

talking_points: Plan attainment, capacity constraints, queue hours per unit and units released for 28 assembly lines across 5 Vietnamese cities.
Every KPI is a numerator over a denominator in a curated dynamic table, so it can be traced back to line-day rows.
The shortfall chart shows which constraint causes cost the most committed units; packaging material shortages lead.
tabs.call_out: One governed set of line capacity KPIs, traceable to source rows

transition.line: Which lines are likely to hit the next constraint?

talking_points: Snowflake ML classification scores each line's probability of a capacity constraint in the next 7 days.
The holdout line shows precision and recall on the most recent labelled days, against the base rate; recall is low, so treat the score as triage.
Anomaly detection flags throughput gap outliers per line, and the forecast projects network-wide plan attainment for 14 days.
tabs.call_out: Honest, evaluated ML inside the data platform

transition.line: How much backup capacity sits behind those risks?

talking_points: Line availability and backup station coverage show how much room each line has when a station goes down.
PM compliance against plan attainment by line shows where the two move together; it is an association, not proof of cause.
The action memo drafts three prioritised actions from the KPI, constraint, cause and risk tables only.
show: Line availability and backup station coverage
tabs.call_out: Grounded draft actions, with a human in the loop

transition.line: What happens when a line alarms right now?

talking_points: Live line-state messages land in RAW.LIVE_TELEMETRY, from the simulator or from AWS IoT Core through Snowpipe.
The Snowflake alert logs ALARM readings with an SOP hint and the line's current risk band, then emails the capacity planner.
tabs.call_out: From line alarm to action in one platform

talking_points: The Cortex Agent uses Cortex Analyst over the semantic view for metrics, and Cortex Search over synthetic line capacity SOPs.
Each answer shows the generated SQL and the SOPs it cited.

transition.line: Here is how it is built.

talking_points: Two builds share one core: Snowflake only, or AWS + Snowflake (IoT Core, Bedrock, QuickSight and Amazon Q).
Everything shown is synthetic demo data, rebuilt reproducibly from the repo.
tabs.call_out: One governed core, with an optional AWS edge
